A deadly overnight strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis killed six people, including surgeons and patients, while at least one death was reported after a separate attack near the entrance to Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital. items.title: Trump says US does not 'need a deal' with Iran
items.desc: Trump says US does not 'need a deal' with Iran US President Donald Trump has said that Washington does not "need a deal" with Iran, claiming "we've got their strait". In a post to his Truth Social account, Trump said: “We don’t need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed. We have got their money, hundreds of billions of dollars and we’ve got their strait.”

items.title: 3 terrorists killed, 2 civilians dead as attack on Mastung post repelled: state media
items.desc: Security forces killed three terrorists on the N-25 highway in Balochistan’s Mastung district while repelling an attack on Kandawa Post, state broadcaster Radio Pakistan reported on Thursday, citing police. items.title: Canadian mining company signs MoU with Mari Energies in South Asia push
items.desc: Ivanhoe Mines signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Mari Energies on Thursday, the Canadian company’s chairman Robert Friedland said on the sidelines of the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum. Friedland said Ivanhoe is in the early stages of setting up a local office in Pakistan and will sign another MoU on Friday. items.title: Nepra notifies Rs25.30 per unit revised special industrial tariff despite concerns
items.desc: ISLAMABAD: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Nepra) on Thursday notified a Rs25.30 per unit revised incremental consumption package (ICP) for industry and agriculture to encourage higher consumption. The order comes despite dissenting notes from two of its four members on Friday, when the authority made the announcement, and protest from industrial consumers. items.title: India probes website blocks based on forged court orders
items.desc: India has launched an inquiry into how telecoms officials blocked websites based on forged court orders, while police have sought ministry records as part of a criminal investigation, officials said on Thursday. An arm of the telecoms ministry this year directed internet providers to block 129 illegal betting websites, but Reuters revealed on Wednesday that the directives were based on forged orders issued in the names of two state high courts and emailed to officials by alleged fraudsters posing as lawyers. The findings have raised questions about safeguards in India’s content-takedown system

items.title: "أنصار الله" تعلن استهداف خط أنابيب "شرق-غرب" وميناء ينبع النفطي وشركة أرامكو في الرياض

items.title: ترامپ: اگر لازم شود، در حمله مجدد به ایران تردید نخواهم کرد
items.desc: دونالد ترامپ که گزارش شده معاون خود را از تیم مذاکره کننده با ایران کنار گذاشته و صراحتا گفته نیازی به توافق با ایران ندارد، در مصاحبه جدیدی تاکید کرده که چنانچه لازم شود در دستور حمله نظامی جدید به ایران تردید نخواهد کرد. همزمان ایران هم تهدید کرده است که هرگونه همکاری کشورها با ارتش آمریکا را مشارکت در جنگ علیه خود تلقی خواهد کرد و حق پاسخگویی برای خود قایل خواهد شد. در آمریکا چهار سناتور کنگره که برنی سندرز یکی از آنهاست، خواستار توقف بودجه جنگ با ایران شده‌اند.
